title: Founding Lead Support Engineer
description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally.

About the role

We are looking for a Founding Lead Support Engineer to establish and lead our enterprise support function while supporting large global enterprise customers using Unframe's AI-powered solutions.

In this founding role, you will be the bridge between our Fortune 500 customers, Product, and Engineering. You will own the technical post-deployment customer experience, dive deep into system architectures, and build the playbooks, processes, and standards that define customer support at Unframe as we scale.

This role is ideal for an experienced technical leader who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys deep-dive troubleshooting, and wants to shape both our support operations and our AI-first workflows from the ground up.

What you'll do

  • Define and build Unframe’s support architecture, SLA frameworks, incident escalation paths, and diagnostic runbooks for our global enterprise coverage.

  • Bring technical authority and a consultative presence to live video calls with enterprise bank executives, sponsors, and engineering leads. Uncover workflow pain points, translate requirements, and manage high-stakes account de-escalations with professional poise.

  • Independently investigate, reproduce, and resolve complex production incidents across web applications, REST APIs, webhooks, microservices, and databases. Query SQL databases, parse CloudWatch/Datadog/Splunk logs, trace JSON payloads, and inspect source code in GitHub to isolate root causes before involving core engineering.

  • Act as an "AI Support Orchestrator," configuring, testing, and deploying autonomous AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, LLM APIs) to analyze logs, automate triage workflows, and build self-service knowledge bases.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to turn recurring customer friction and edge cases into actionable product specs, bug fixes, and feature enhancements.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in Technical Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, QA, or SRE within complex enterprise or B2B SaaS environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to build processes, set technical standards, and mentor engineering colleagues in a fast-paced startup setting.

  • Diagnostic Tech Stack:

    • Hands-on proficiency writing complex SQL queries to inspect relational and cloud databases.

    • Practical experience conducting deep log analysis in CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or Loki.

    • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON payloads, webhooks, HTTP status codes, and browser DevTools.

    • Direct working familiarity with enterprise authentication protocols (SSO, SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, Okta).

  • Daily practitioner of generative AI and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot) for log parsing, code navigation, and workflow automation.

  • Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with proven experience advising enterprise executives on live technical calls.

Why join us?

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys solving real technical problems while working closely with customers, product, and engineering teams. You’ll be exposed to complex enterprise environments, cutting-edge AI products, and fast product cycles with real ownership and direct impact from day one. It’s an opportunity to grow quickly, learn how large-scale AI systems are deployed in the real world, and help shape the experience of some of the world’s biggest companies using Unframe.

  • Eight or more years of customer-facing technical experience in enterprise IT, SaaS, data protection, backup and recovery, cloud, infrastructure, technical consulting, pre-sales engineering, technical account management, solutions architecture, or related fields.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend) - Global Marts
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Who We Are

Global Marts builds the technology behind DoorDash's own grocery and retail operations across DashMart, Wolt Market, and Deliveroo Hop.

Our systems decide what products our stores stock, how much inventory to purchase, which vendors to source from, how warehouses execute orders, and what prices customers see.

We build everything from forecasting and replenishment systems to vendor management, warehouse execution, labor scheduling, space optimization, and pricing. Our in-house forecasting platform has replaced third-party solutions and now powers production globally.

This isn't a traditional CRUD backend environment. Much of our work involves designing new systems that solve complex operational problems at global scale.

 

What You'll Do

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll work primarily with Go or Kotlin and take end-to-end ownership of production systems and complex technical initiatives.

You'll:

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems that support inventory, purchasing, warehouse operations, pricing, and fulfillment.
  • Own technical solutions from problem definition and design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operation.
  • Work on data-heavy systems where software engineering meets forecasting, optimization, and operational decision-making.
  • Turn complex and sometimes ambiguous business problems into pragmatic, scalable technical solutions.
  • Make and influence architectural decisions, balancing scalability, reliability, development speed, and long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations teams to shape solutions and technical direction.
  • Improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and operational excellence of the systems you own.
  • Support and raise the engineering standards of the team through technical discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively while applying strong engineering judgment to validate their output, improve development velocity, and identify opportunities where AI can create additional leverage.

 

How We Work

  • Autonomy & Ownership: Engineers have end-to-end responsibility for their services, from design and implementation to production and on-call.
  • Collaboration: Architecture and technical direction are shaped together. Senior engineers are expected to contribute actively to decisions and help others arrive at strong solutions.
  • Scalability & Simplicity: We value pragmatic solutions that solve today's problems while providing a sustainable foundation for tomorrow.
  • Impact: We work closely with Product, Data Science, and Operations, connecting technical decisions directly to real-world retail and operational outcomes.

 

Our Tech Stack

Our primary backend languages are Go and Kotlin.

We also use Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Snowflake, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, GitHub Actions, and modern cloud infrastructure.

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We're more interested in strong backend and distributed systems fundamentals and your ability to learn and make sound technical decisions.

 

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who:

  • Have strong experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems.
  • Have professional experience with Go, Kotlin, or another modern backend language.
  • Have experience owning services end-to-end, including design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, reliability, and production operations.
  • Have strong knowledge of backend and distributed systems fundamentals, including APIs, databases, asynchronous processing, failure handling, testing, and observability.
  • Are comfortable working with data-heavy systems and technologies such as Kafka, Snowflake, or similar streaming and data infrastructure.
  • Can navigate ambiguous problems, break them into actionable steps, make appropriate technical trade-offs, and deliver incrementally.
  • Can influence technical decisions beyond their immediate tasks and collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional partners.
  • Communicate technical concepts and decisions clearly and concisely.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively in their everyday engineering workflow while critically evaluating generated solutions and taking full ownership of the resulting code and technical decisions.
  • Look for opportunities to use AI to improve engineering productivity and solve problems more effectively, while understanding where human engineering judgment remains essential.

 

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following is a plus:

  • Forecasting, optimization, scheduling, recommendation, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, logistics, supply chain, or warehouse technology.
  • ERP, vendor management, procurement, or workforce management integrations.
  • Replacing third-party or legacy platforms with internally built systems.
  • High-throughput event-driven or streaming architectures.

 

Why Join Us?

You'll help build the technology that powers DoorDash's global grocery and retail business, solving complex operational challenges across inventory, forecasting, fulfillment, pricing, and supply chain.

You'll have significant ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence technical direction while working closely with experienced engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations teams across multiple markets.

📍 This role is based in our tech hub in Helsinki or Stockholm. We work in distributed teams, but may not be able to support fully remote work or relocation.

 

Next Steps

We're reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.

You can read more about our recruitment process here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
